open_items.evidence: Primary NEJM 2022 and 2025 reports show pCR 24.0% vs 2.2%, 2-year EFS 63.8% vs 45.3%, and 5-year OS 65.4% vs 55.0%. Existing page had data-benefit 10.00 despite a 10.4-point OS difference and three numeric NNTs without endpoint-specific structured records.
open_items.action: Corrected pCR absolute difference to 21.8 points; added separate structured endpoint/horizon/NNT records for EFS, pCR and OS; corrected OS data-benefit to 10.4.
open_items.verification: Cross-checked NEJMoa2202170 and NEJMoa2502931; arithmetic ceil(100/difference): EFS 6, pCR 5, OS 10. Static page markup reread.
open_items.next_action: Await the exact-30 PR gate and merge before closing on main
